materials.name: AS/NZS 3679.1 300
materials.note: Copied from the existing AU materials file; fy/fu agree with the printout for flats and sections (the same printout lists 320 MPa for grade 350 rounds/squares/hexagons). The manufacturer catalogue (InfraBuild Ed.9, Tables 10 etc.) shows thickness-dependent fy for sections: 300PLUS flange 280-300 / web 300-320 MPa (fu 440); grade 350 flange/web 340-360 MPa (fu 480). So fy 280 / 330 are conservative lower bounds, not a per-thickness table. G=80000 is the AS 4100 value (not in the printout).
